_comment: D1 depth-surface baseline (PLAN-01 chunk 5; re-pinned by chunk 6 / D1b). The census is the output of `bun run scripts/depth-census.ts` over the suite emitted by the binary named below, generated NON-colocated (the D0-mirrored shape: the out-dir planes only — flawless/unit + flawless/browser). The subject is the committed depth-surface fixture (tests/fixtures/depthapp): one component per pattern the track-D plans measure (P1–P10 present/absent shapes, N1/N2 refusal controls, plus the home page and the document-root layout). `patterns` pins, per id, the emitted spec path, the assertion text found there — or 'not emitted — <reason>' naming the plan item that owns the missing behaviour — and the tier the classifier measures. tests/depthSurface.test.ts generates the same fixture colocated and cross-checks this file: a found assertion must still be emitted and every tier must still hold. Two fresh copies of the fixture generated with the binary below produced byte-identical census JSON (sha256 eb32f861cd4ce219ef91eb625d3b54c4301b0e36344d26538c34343b7d79cc5c) — the census is deterministic. D1b delta vs the chunk-5 pin (T0 12 / T1 12 / T2 2 / T3 0): P4 and P5 crossed T1→T2 — item 3's dispatch-driven request count and item 4's branch mirror pair are behaviour claims under the amended tier table; T1 12→10, T2 2→4, T0 unchanged.

P1.note: D1 item 1 (shipped). The classifier reads toBeDisabled as T2 (src/reporters/depth.ts:521); the D1a receipt calls it T1 — the census records the classifier's reading.

P2.note: D1 item 2 (shipped). The multi-line byte shape is what biome's formatter emits; the assertion is the string→attribute initial.

P3.note: D1 item 7 (salvaged on this branch). Button A (testid rung) also asserts toHaveAttribute("role", "button"); button B (label rung) asserts ONLY the role — expect(screen.getAllByLabelText("Open menu")[0] as HTMLElement).toHaveAttribute("role", "button") — exactly one aria-label assert exists in the spec (anti-tautology).

P4.assertion:
await userEvent.click(screen.getAllByRole("button", { name: "Load items" })[0] as HTMLElement);
    await waitFor(() => expect(calls).toBeGreaterThan(0), { timeout: 3000 });
P4.note: D1 item 3 (shipped, D1b). The fetch is fired from the click handler, so every fetch test dispatches first; the request count read after a dispatch is T2 (amended PLAN-00 request-count row). The mount-fetch shape (P8) stays T0.

P5.note: D1 item 4 (shipped, D1b). Branch witnesses: the prop-keyed ternary asserts the presence/absence mirror pair per branch — each leg renders its own literal and asserts the other absent. Branch literals stay out of the unconditional static-content loop (extractStaticText.ts:15). T2 per the table: falsified by swapping the branches.

P6.assertion: not emitted — D1 item 5 (PLAN-01) unshipped: classifyLogical yields a trigger only when both operands name the SAME single dep, so emitGuardTests skips the two-dep guard; the spec carries only the generic RSC contract (T0 non-empty render)

P7.assertion: not emitted — D1 item 6 (PLAN-01) unshipped: the variant matrix is capped at five options (xs–xl emitted); '2xl'/'3xl'/'4xl' appear nowhere in the spec

P8.assertion: not emitted — D2 (PLAN-02) unshipped: the four msw fetch-state tests exist (FIXTURE = { greeting: "Hello from the API" }, waitFor call-count) but the fixture value is never asserted — every test ends in TODO(flawless)

P9.assertion: not emitted — D3 (PLAN-03) unshipped: no text witness for the setter transition; 'No visits'/'Visited' appear nowhere (ternary branch texts are not extracted as static text); the click is a canary

P10.assertion: not emitted — D4 (PLAN-04) unshipped: client mock mode is allowlist-only so the server-action module stays real; the form test fills and reads back (toHaveValue) but asserts nothing about the action call (no toHaveBeenCalledWith, no vi.mocked)

N1.assertion: not emitted — refusal control: `pending || flags?.pending` does not reduce at any generated DEFAULTS (flags is a Pick both resolvers refuse, floored to {}), so the emitter names the skip ('its control is disabled at these props') and asserts no toBeDisabled

N2.assertion: not emitted — refusal control: readStringInitializer is literals-only, so the template-literal aria-label is never recorded; the locator falls to the role rung (getAllByRole button 'Save') and no aria-label is asserted

home.note: The composed page: no props, no interactions of its own, no static-content describe (its JSX is all component references).

root.assertion: test("RootLayout returns a document root containing its children", async () => {
root.note: Document-root contract checked as server markup (renderToReadableStream), not mounted.

crossCheck.note: Committed colocated copies (*.flawless.test.ts(x) outside the out dir). Explicitly excluded from `headline`: the census subject is the suite this run emitted.
